main_text.l: CEPHALALGIA BILIOSA CVRA-tur sex ijsdem præsidiorum generibus.

VICTVS ratione refrigerante, et hu-mectante, ob id gigni prohibente, aut genitam temperante bilem flauam, omnium quæ in corpore sunt calidissimam & siccam: qualis victus ratio febricitantibus omnibus est salubris indicatione à febri sumpta.

l.i: Vt, aëre frigido, humido qualem arte & in dustria machinari docet Galenus lib. metho. 9. & 10. calidis omnibus prohibitis, et in cu-biculum illatis refrigerantibus et humec-tantibus plantis, & liquoribus paulo ante re-citatis.

Vt, potu aquæ, aut vini aquosi, et aqua mul-ta diluti, aut pomatij, pyratij, imbecillis. Fru-ctibus etiā crudis, pomis, pyris acidis, lactu-ca, portulaca, intybis, oxalide, spinacio, lac-te, caseo recenti, melca, aphrogalacte, pane loto, vel hordeaceo, tenero, piscibus, aut par-tibus animalium nervosis.

page.notes: Old-style long s rendered as s; the ligatures "ct", "st" and the ampersand forms were copied as printed. The Greek-style ligature in "præsidiorum" is read as printed. Marginal number "1." is the only note.
